summary_en: Interim dividend of ¥93/share (¥63 ordinary + ¥30 30th anniversary special), total ¥1,687M, record date 30 June 2026, effective 4 September 2026. Policy: stable dividend targeting 50% payout ratio until operating profit reaches ¥10B.
title_en: Notice of Surplus Dividend (Interim Dividend including 30th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
BASE Co., Ltd. resolved on 14 August 2026 to pay an interim dividend of ¥93 per share (record date 30 June 2026, effective 4 September 2026). The dividend comprises ¥63 ordinary dividend and ¥30 commemorative dividend marking the company's 30th anniversary, totalling ¥1,687 million.

The company's dividend policy targets a payout ratio of approximately 50% until operating profit reaches ¥10 billion, paired with secure internal reserves for future business development and financial strengthening. The interim and year-end dividends are paid twice annually. This interim dividend aligns with prior guidance issued 13 February 2026.

Full-year FY2026 dividend forecast stands at ¥186 per share (¥126 ordinary + ¥60 commemorative), compared to ¥117 per share in FY2025 (¥57 interim + ¥60 year-end).
